newsitem.title: USA: Data Translation sets stock spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Data Translation sets stock spinoff.

text.p: Data Translation Inc said its board of directors declared the payment of a dividend of one share of common stock of its Data Translation II Inc unit for every four shares of Data Translation common.
The record date is November 29, and the effective date is December 2.

The company also said that, with the spinoff, it intends to change its name to Media 100 Inc, reflecting its sole focus on its remaining business. Beginning December 3, it will use the stock symbol MDEA on Nasdaq.
The spun-off company will change its name to Data Translation Inc, and will assume the DATX Nasdaq stock symbol.

After the completion of the spinoff, the new firm will own and operate the company's data acquisition and imaging and commercial products businesses, while the parent company will retain its Media 100 business.
